subject: Critical Hit
text: If a hit is a Critical Hit, it will do twice the character's Damage rating, regardless of the enemy's defense.

evidence.quote:
If one of your hits is a Critical Hit, it 
will do twice your Damage rating, regardless of the enemy's defense.

subject: Experience
text: Experience is divided equally among surviving, non-stoned party members, rounded down unless it is less than one, which yields 1 experience.

evidence.quote:
When you get experience, the set number will be divided equally 
amongst the number of non-stoned surviving members of the party, those who cheer 
when the battle is over.  Note a few things:  If the experience is less than 
one, you will get one.  Otherwise, it will be rounded down.

subject: Evade
text: Base Evade is calculated by adding 48 to Agility, then subtracting armor.

evidence.quote:
In Final Fantasy, Agility will have 
the function of determining your Evade stat.  Add 48 to this number to get your 
base Evade, then subtract your armor*.

subject: CURE
text: The CURE spell always restores between 16 and 32 HP.

evidence.quote: For example, CURE always restores somewhere in between 16 and 32 HP.

subject: Vitality
text: One more Hit Point is added to the level-up formula for every 4 points of Vitality gained.

evidence.quote:
Basically, 1 more Hit Point will be added to the formula for every 4 
points of Vitality you gain*.

subject: Damage
text: Damage is equal to the equipped weapon's Damage value plus half of the character's strength.

evidence.quote:
Damage is equal to your weapon's Damage value plus half your 
strength.

subject: Hit
text: Characters start making more than one hit per attack around Level 8 or 9.

evidence.quote:
Furthermore, 
if you have a very high Hit Percent, you may actually hit the enemy several 
times, not just once.  You will notice your characters will start to make more 
than one hit around Level 8 or 9.

subject: Master
text: For Masters who equip armor and level up, Absorb reverts to their level until visiting the armor screen again, allowing them to gain the benefits of the Ribbon and ProRing without forfeiting high natural Absorb.

evidence.quote:
But, for Masters, 
if you equip a piece of armor, then level up, the Absorb value will revert to 
your level until you visit your armor screen again.  Even if you turn the system 
off, or use a piece of armor in battle, your Absorb will still be your level 
until you hit start, then go to armor and press A.  So, you will be able to get 
the benefits of the Ribbon and ProRing without forfeiting the Master's naturally 
high Absorb value.

subject: Black Belt
text: A Black Belt's DAMAGE always equals twice his level, provided he has no weapon equipped.

evidence.quote:
For some reason, his DAMAGE always equals twice his level, provided he 
has no weapon equipped.

subject: Black Belt
text: A Black Belt's ABSORB equals his level if unarmored, reaching up to 50 defense at Level 50.

evidence.quote:
Much unlike any other character as well, his ABSORB 
equals his level if he does not have any armor equipped. ... While his Absorb can get up to 50, provided he is at Level 50, he does have 
pretty good defense.

subject: Black Belt
text: By Level 30, a Black Belt is able to do over 1000 damage to almost any monster.

evidence.quote:
While it will 
take time, by Level 30, he'll be able to do over 1000 damage to just about any 
monster there is!
